rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.MutuallyExclusive/FlagErrorf, heredoc.Docf, api.HandleHTTPError, ghinstance helpers and httpmock idioms; but test.go pulls testing/testify into a production package and mimics maintainer TODO initials.
rationale.edge_cases: Very thorough: SameFile dedupe, '#' in filenames via stat, '-' refused, video alt refused, code spans/fences, reference defs, blockquote continuation, escaped alt re-parse check, 404-as-permission, Retry-After, GetBody for redirects.
rationale.scope: Deliberately writes the body after a partial upload failure, contrary to 'if one upload fails nothing is written'; unused UploadStub type; hasDeferredEdits refactor and extra databaseId selections beyond the ask.
rationale.readability: Clear names and structure, but comments are dense and prose-heavy, references.go is 800 lines of hand-rolled link scanning, and issue-edit's nothingWritten heuristic is hard to follow.
rationale.robustness: Bounds-checked edits, bodies/files closed, ctx threaded, nil Repository guarded, ordered refusals before any request; nil AttachFlag would panic and openFile is a mutable global test hook.
rationale.maintainability: Well-split package, but uploader construction is copy-pasted across five commands, the bespoke position scanner is fragile against goldmark changes, and nothingWritten couples to Editable.Dirty semantics.
